name: – Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares – After § 70 – Am 13
title: REPORT on a revamped long-term budget for the Union in a changing world
part_text: 70a. Draws attention to the fact that, in recent years, the Commission has been funding an increasing number of non-governmental organisations (NGOs) that are engaged in political activities, as the European Court of Auditors’ report has also highlighted, while the funding of NGOs has been carried out in a non-transparent manner; highlights the fact that this practice strongly contradicts the values of a genuine civil society; considers, therefore, that it is important for the requirements of transparency to be fully applied to contracts concluded by the Commission and all other EU institutions; demands that the funding of organisations that engage in political activities should be carefully scrutinised to avoid distorting European democracy and thus undermining voters’ faith in democratic values;
